---
title: "Quality of life — primary preparation"
subtitle: "Inverted Q30 states, principal-stratum survivors, and death-inclusive data"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

QoL state 1 is the best state after the SAP inversion (`8 - Q30`). The
principal-stratum artifact contains participants observed alive at day 182;
the separate death-inclusive artifact retains all participants and assigns the
absorbing state 8 from the recorded death week onward for the SAP decision rule.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
cohort_path <- project_path("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
qol_path <- project_path("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-qol.parquet")
cohort_schema_path <- project_path("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
qol_schema_path <- project_path("data", "schema", "qol.yml")
output_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life"))
principal_path <- file.path(output_dir, "prepared.parquet")
death_inclusive_path <- file.path(output_dir, "death-inclusive-prepared.parquet")
stage_id <- "primary-qol-preparation"
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "data-validation.R"),
  here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"), here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"),
  here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"), knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-qol-data
#| include: false
module_branch(
  runtime = runtime,
  stage_id = stage_id,
  input_paths = c(cohort_path, qol_path, cohort_schema_path, qol_schema_path),
  output_paths = c(principal_path, death_inclusive_path),
  code_paths = code_paths,
  metadata = list(endpoint = "quality_of_life", horizon_weeks = 26L, state_inversion = "8-q30"),
  worker = function() {
    cohort <- module_input(cohort_path, cohort_schema_path)
    qol <- module_input(qol_path, qol_schema_path)
    module_require_columns(
      cohort,
      c("id", "randomization_date", "tx", "diagnosis", "death_date", "follow_up_end_date"),
      "cohort_follow_up"
    )
    module_require_columns(qol, c("id", "assessment_id", "day", "q30", "baseline_q30"), "qol")
    cohort <- derive_survival_endpoint(
      cohort,
      origin_col = "randomization_date",
      death_date_col = "death_date",
      follow_up_end_col = "follow_up_end_date",
      lock_date = parse_analysis_date(config$analysis$data_lock, "data_lock", allow_missing = FALSE),
      horizon_days = 182L
    )
    cohort$ecog_fstcnt <- if ("ecog_fstcnt" %in% names(cohort)) cohort$ecog_fstcnt else NA_integer_
    cohort$event_death <- as.integer(cohort$event_death)
    cohort$survival_time_days <- as.numeric(cohort$survival_time_days)
    base <- cohort[
      , c("id", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "event_death", "survival_time_days"),
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    base$diagnosis <- as.integer(factor(base$diagnosis, levels = sort(unique(base$diagnosis))))
    weeks <- data.frame(week = 1:26)
    grid <- merge(base, weeks, by = NULL)
    observations <- qol[qol$day > 0 & qol$day <= 182, c("id", "day", "q30", "baseline_q30"), drop = FALSE]
    observations$week <- pmax(1L, pmin(26L, ceiling(observations$day / 7)))
    observations <- observations[order(observations$id, observations$week, observations$day), , drop = FALSE]
    observations <- observations[!duplicated(observations[c("id", "week")], fromLast = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    grid <- merge(grid, observations[, c("id", "week", "q30", "baseline_q30"), drop = FALSE],
                  by = c("id", "week"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
    grid$y <- q30_to_analysis_state(grid$q30, strict = FALSE)
    grid$baseline_state <- q30_to_analysis_state(grid$baseline_q30, strict = FALSE)
    grid <- grid[order(grid$id, grid$week), , drop = FALSE]
    grid$death_week <- ifelse(
      grid$event_death == 1L,
      pmax(1L, pmin(26L, ceiling(grid$survival_time_days / 7))),
      27L
    )
    death_inclusive <- grid
    death_inclusive$y_death_inclusive <- ifelse(
      death_inclusive$week >= death_inclusive$death_week, 8L,
      death_inclusive$y
    )
    principal <- grid[grid$event_death == 0L, , drop = FALSE]
    principal <- principal[principal$week <= 26L, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(principal) == 0L) stop("No observed 26-week survivors are available for primary QoL.")
    module_save_parquet(principal, principal_path)
    module_save_parquet(death_inclusive, death_inclusive_path)
  }
)
```
